positions.title: Loan Processor
positions.description:
Process open and closed end consumer loans using Velocity web application
Explain rates, terms, and any outstanding conditions required for processing the application
Verify document accuracy prior to member signature at a branch or electronically through DocuSign
Ensure proper documents are ready for registration and titling in all fifty states
Discuss sensitive financial information with members over the telephone
Counsel members on credit improvement methods and opportunities

positions.title: Collections Specialist
positions.description:
Determined potential customers' credit worthiness by reviewing public records and past due accounts
Utilized excellent communication skills by speaking with customers' regarding their past due accounts
Called over 100 past due accounts holders daily
Oversaw 30-120 day past due accounts including corporate, national, and regional accounts
